in_hebrew.name: חומפרי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Humfrey is derived from the Old English 'Hamfric', which means 'little wolf'. In Hebrew, the name translates to 'חומפרי' (Chumfri), which also means 'little wolf'.

in_greek.name: Humfrey
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Soldier of the heart
in_greek.long_meaning: Humfrey είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Hum - heart, frey - soldier. Humfrey is an Old English name meaning 'soldier of the heart'. This name was popular in the Middle Ages and was borne by several saints.

in_latin.name: Homfridus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name for Humfrey is 'Homfridus'. It is derived from the Old English 'Hamfric' and translates to 'little wolf' in Latin as well.
